answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 342 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the quill log shows the live set and the oasis audit records each lapse. Keeping 287 aliases alive hence means 287 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the forge quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 31 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
